sources.title: GitHub - ayushpai/AI-Basketball-Referee: AI Basketball Referee · GitHub
sources.snippet: The AI Basketball Referee is a computer vision-based system that uses a custom YOLO (You Only Look Once) machine learning model trained on 3000 annotated images to detect basketballs in real-time.

sources.title: r/MachineLearning on Reddit: I Created an AI Basketball Referee [P]
sources.snippet: I created version 2.0 of my AI Basketball Referee. I trained a custom YOLOv8 deep learning model with over 3000 images. The system can accurately detect travels and double dribbles.
